name: Disk Usage Details
author: Mehmood

sections.description:
Disk Usage Details helps you understand exactly where your disk space is being used. It scans your WordPress installation and displays the size of folders and files, making it easy to identify large directories and manage your website storage.

Features:

  • View the size of each folder and file, sorted from largest to smallest.
  • Click any folder to drill down into its contents.
  • See percentage-based size indicators to quickly identify large items.
  • Progressive scanning keeps the page responsive while calculating folder sizes.
  • Results are cached for one hour to improve performance.
  • Clear the cache and rescan with one click.
  • Displays total disk space used, free space, and available storage.
  • Works directly from the WordPress Tools menu.

The Disk Usage Details screen is available under the Tools menu. Only administrators with the manage_options capability can access it.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Tools → Disk Usage Details to start analyzing your disk usage.
sections.faq:
Who can see this screen?

Only users with the manage_options capability (administrators) can access Disk Usage Details.

Does it delete or modify any files?

No. Disk Usage Details only reads file and folder sizes. It does not modify, move, or delete any files.

Why is a folder size shown as “computing”?

Large folders are scanned progressively in the background to keep the page fast. Once the calculation is complete, the result is cached for faster loading.
